text:
nina: usability finding from the lab: when a tool-call fails due to schema issues testers see a red dot in run history but don't know what to do next. need a clearer path to triage.

pete: idea: add a "mini-diff" affordance inline in the run row. a single-line summary + chevron expands a compact diff panel beneath that run. keeps timeline compact.

rachel: accessibility thoughts: announce with a live region when the mini-diff opens: 'Mini diff opened, 2 schema issues for run 18'. focus should go to the first actionable element, and Escape closes and returns focus to the run item.

oliver: copy nit: current pill label "Fix schema" feels too prescriptive. propose "Review issues" or "Open schema". testers assumed automatic changes with "Fix".

nina: +1 on "Review issues". also show a tiny badge with the count: e.g. "Schema · 2" so it's explicit.

pete: keyboard flow: allow J/K to navigate runs, then press Enter to open run, or press I to open inline issues for focused run. include a tooltip that lists shortcuts.

rachel: visual a11y: error chips must meet contrast 4.5:1 in compact mode. don't rely on color alone: add icons and an underline state for keyboard focus. aria-describedby should point to an explanation element describing the constraint.

oliver: runtime detail: include the failing json path + constraint in monospace, truncated to one line with middle ellipsis if > 120 chars. example: 

```
payload.user.age: expected integer <= 120, got string "thirty"
```

that helped debug sessions move faster.

nina: UX question: should inline mini-diff be editable? i'd rather it be preview-only with a clear "Open full editor to apply" CTA to avoid accidental commits.

pete: agreed. preview-only by default. add an "Apply suggestion" button that opens the editor with the patch preloaded — explicit commit step.

rachel: test case for screen readers: ensure the mini-diff's expand/collapse control is announced as a toggle and exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls. also ensure the suggested patch has role="region" with a descriptive aria-label.

oliver: analytics: track events: run_lint_shown, run_lint_expanded, run_lint_cta_click, lint_count. include first_issue_path when available.

nina: ok action items: pete -> prototype compact mini-diff and keyboard spec by Wed; oliver -> analytics evt spec; rachel -> a11y checklist & contrast tests; i'll draft copy variants and PR note. @a11y-bot queue SR reminder when prototype link posted.

a11y-bot: reminder queued: run SR checklist when prototype link is available.

nina: thanks all — should make postmortem-less debugging much easier for tool-calls. :sparkles:
